title: Choose the look for DRAX RAW
question: My pick: make the site a Bongo movie poster with Drax as the star. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Starring: DRAX
options.lineage: Bongo movie DVD sleeves and Dar cinema posters
options.thesis: The whole site is a movie release where Drax is the star and every credit in the billing block is his.
options.viewport: Drax's cutout huge as the poster star, 'DRAX RAW' in tall condensed letters, a billing block at the bottom: SHOT BY DRAX, EDITED BY DRAX, COLORED BY DRAX, and a WhatsApp 'BOOK NOW' ticket.
options.risk: Can feel cheesy if the type and photos are not handled with real poster craft.

options.label: Plane Portrait
options.thesis: Drax's portrait rebuilt from a few bold flat color shapes on a calm grid.
options.case: Striking and artsy, but less instantly 'filmmaker' to a client scrolling on a phone.

options.label: Road Case
options.lineage: gear cases covered in tour stickers
options.thesis: His camera case covered in stickers, each film and client a sticker you peel back.
options.case: Great for musicians and street energy; harder to read for NGOs and brands.

options.label: Neon Sign
options.thesis: DRAX RAW as a hand-bent neon sign that lights up in a dark room, each section a sign switching on.
options.case: Beautiful first screen, but fuses poorly with the photos and films, which are the real proof.

canonCard.label: Classic filmmaker portfolio
canonCard.thesis: Clean dark portfolio: showreel, film grid, about, contact, done very well.
canonCard.viewport: Full-screen showreel video with name and a contact button.
